The '''1995–96 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 65th since its establishment. It began on 2 September 1995, and concluded on 26 May 1996.

===Notes===
* With [[CP Mérida|Mérida]]'s promotion every [[Autonomous communities of Spain|Spanish autonomous community]] (though not every [[Provinces of Spain|province]]) has been represented in [[La Liga|Primera División]].
* Initially, only 20 teams would play this season in [[La Liga|Primera División]], but [[Sevilla FC]] and [[Celta de Vigo]] were relegated to [[Segunda División B]] for not making their payments to the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation]]. Then, [[Albacete Balompié|Albacete]] and [[Real Valladolid]], initially relegated, were readmitted in [[La Liga|Primera División]]. Later, [[Sevilla FC]] and [[Celta de Vigo]] were also readmitted and the league was expanded to 22 teams for two seasons.
* From this season on, wins were awarded 3 points instead of 2 (similar to other domestic leagues that had 3-1-0 team scoring point format).
